title_en: Exploring the Potential of Using Large Language Models (LLMs) for Evaluating Korean Learners’ Writing: A Comparison GPT-4o and GPT-4.5
kw_ko: 한국어교육; 쓰기; 자동 평가

abstract_ko: This study explores the possibility of using Large Language Models (LLMs) as tools for evaluating Korean writing by examining the agreement between human raters and GPT models (GPT-4o, GPT-4.5). Intraclass correlation coefficients (ICCs) were computed to assess the level of agreement between scores assigned by human raters and the GPT models on essays written by Korean learners. The ICC for total scores between human raters and GPT-4o was .664, while the ICC with GPT-4.5 was .794, indicating good and excellent agreement, respectively. However, both models showed poor agreement with human raters in “sociolinguistic competence” and “linguistic diversity.” Kruskal-Wallis H tests with post-hoc analyses also revealed significant differences in scores among the three raters in most evaluation categories. Although GPT models demonstrated human-like tendencies in some areas, clear discrepancies were observed in others. These findings suggest that GPT models have considerable potential as supplementary tools in automated writing evaluation, though careful attention to evaluation domains and model behavior is required.

abstract_ko: 본 논문은 인공지능 장치 수용이론(AIDUA)을 바탕으로 베트남에서 한국어 학습자의 ChatGPT(Chat Generative Pre-trained Transformer) 수용 의도에 영향을 미치는 요인을 분석하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 이를 위해 의인화, 쾌락적 동기, 사회적 영향, 노력 기대 및 성과기대, 감정, 신뢰 그리고 학습자 수용 의도 등으로 나누어 총 8개의 변수 간의 구조적인 영향을 탐색하였다. 본 연구를 위해 베트남 호찌민 지역 한국어 학습자 324명을 대상으로 구조화된 자가 평가식 설문지를 활용하여 자료를 수집하였다. 또한 AIDUA 모형을 기반으로 설정한 연구 모형과 가설을 검증하기 위해 수집된 자료를 구조방정식 모형(PLS-SEM)을 사용하여 분석하였다. 본 연구의 분석 결과는 다음과 같다. 첫째, 의인화는 노력 기대와 성과기대에 각각 유의미한 영향을 미치는 것으로 나타났다. 둘째, 쾌락적 동기는 성과기대 또한 노력 기대에 각각 유의미한 영향을 미치는 것으로 확인되었다. 셋째, 사회적 영향은 노력 기대와 성과기대에 각각 통계적으로 유의미한 영향을 미치는 것으로 나타났다. 넷째, 성과기대와 노력 기대는 감정에 각각 유의미한 영향을 미치는 것으로 밝혀졌다. 다섯째, 신뢰는 학습자 수용 의도에 유의미한 영향을 미치는 결과가 나타났다. 여섯째, 감정은 학습자 수용 의도에 유의미한 영향을 미치는 결과로 확인되었다. 본 연구의 결과는 ChatGPT에 대한 한국어 학습자의 수용 과정을 심층적으로 이해하는 데 도움이 될 뿐이 아니라, 외국어교육 분야에서 새롭게 제안된 등장한 AIDUA 모형의 이론적 유용성과 실천적 타당성을 검토하는 데에도 중요한 시사점을 제공할 것으로 기대한다.
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to analyze the process of forming the behavioral intention of ChatGPT among Vietnamese learners of Korean based on the Artificially Intelligent Device Use Acceptance (AIDUA) model. To achieve this, the study explores the structural relationships among eight variables: social influence, hedonic motivation, anthropomorphism, performance expectancy, effort expectancy, learners’ affect, trust, and behavioral intention. For this research, data were collected using a structured self-assessment questionnaire from 324 Korean language learners in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

abstract_ko: Objectives: The demand for Korean language learning has increased with global interest in Korean culture. However, non-native speakers struggle with pronunciation due to Korean's unique phonological features. This study aims to develop an AI-based pronunciation evaluation application to provide structured and personalized feedback. Methods: The system uses a client–server architecture, integrating an Android app, a FastAPI server, and an SQLite database. The AI model evaluates pronunciation based on accuracy, fluency, and completeness, and checks keyword usage in learners' spoken responses. Results: A pilot study with non-native Korean learners showed high user satisfaction with the system’s learning content and feedback quality. Conclusions: The AI-based application effectively supports Korean pronunciation learning by offering real-time, structured feedback. Pilot results suggest strong potential for broader application in Korean language education.

abstract_ko: This study investigates and validates lexical features for the automated assessment of Korean learners’ writing proficiency. Using Korean Language learners’ corpus (n=14,992), features were extracted across five categories: lexical diversity, lexical density, lexical difficulty, morpheme usage, and text length. Pearson correlation analysis demonstrated statistically significant correlations between these features and learner proficiency levels. Classification models using Random Forest and XGBoost were trained to evaluate predictive performance. Lexical difficulty and morpheme usage emerged as the most effective predictors, with features such as the number of Level 4 vocabulary types, the ratio of Level 1 words, and sentence-final endings showing high importance. Combining all feature types, the integrated model achieved 87.9% accuracy with the XGBoost model, outperforming individual models and confirming that lexical difficulty and grammatical complexity are key indicators in automated writing assessment. This research highlights the potential of linguistic features in developing reliable, high-accuracy machine learning models for assessing second language writing proficiency.

abstract_ko: This study explored the potential of artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools in Korean reading fluency instruction for beginner learners whose first language is Japanese, and it analyzed their perceptions and attitudes toward such instruction. Microsoft’s ‘Reading Progress’ was implemented in an actual classroom setting, followed by a survey to examine the learners’ responses. The analysis revealed that learners experienced improvements in key components of reading fluency, such as pronunciation accuracy, sentence-level reading, and prosody. They also reported increased confidence and interest in reading activities. These findings suggest that AI-based reading activities can effectively support both the cognitive and affective aspects of learning. Based on these results, this study proposes three practical directions for designing AI-assisted Korean reading fluency instruction. First, the instructional design should align with the core components of fluency and enable the effective use of automatic feedback functions. Second, repetitive learning structures and flexible assessment systems that promote learner motivation should be incorporated. Third, it is important to ensure technical reliability and user accessibility through clear guidance and learner support. While this study is limited as it did not empirically verify instructional effectiveness and was restricted to a specific learner group, it contributes by presenting a concrete classroom-based case in an underexplored area of Korean language education. These findings are expected to serve as foundational data for future research and practice in AI-supported reading fluency instruction.

The core features include automatic scoring, Digital Game-Based Learning (DGBL), and a Content Management System (CMS). The application provides real-time pronunciation scores by combining Speech-To-Text (STT) and sentence transformer similarity check technologies, enabling users to improve pronunciation accuracy interactively. The DGBL feature supports Korean learning through stage-based games and evaluates performance via the scoring system to determine progression. Lastly, the CMS supports dynamic game content management, enabling flexible updates. The system was built using Python, Flutter, React.js, FastAPI, and MySQL, with an average response time of approximately 0.254 seconds, demonstrating effective real-time feedback. Future updates will include improved user interfaces, machine learning-based scoring models, and dynamic question generation using large language models (LLMs), which are expected to enhance long-term engagement and offer continuous learning opportunities.

abstract_ko: 본 연구는 초등학교 서술형 평가의 채점 부담을 완화하고 평가의 신뢰성을 높이기 위해 인공지능 기반 자동채점 서비스를 개발하고 그 효과성을 검증하였다. 이를 위해 한국교육과정평가원이 개발한 초등학교 5학년 국어과 서술형 평가 문항을 활용하여 맞춤형 GPT 모델을 구축하고, Google Workspace 플랫폼과 연동한 자동채점 서비스를 개발하였다. 개발된 서비스의 성능을 검증하기 위해 101명의 학생 답안을 대상으로 교사 평가, 자동채점 서비스, ChatGPT 세 가지 방식으로 채점을 수행하고 그 결과를 비교․분석하였다. 분석 결과 자동채점 서비스는 대부분의 문항에서 교사 평가와 높은 일치도(이차 가중 카파계수 0.63 ~ 0.83)를 보였으며, 특히 평가 기준이 명확하고 구조화된 문항에서 우수한 성능을 나타냈다. 또한 ChatGPT와 비교했을 때 교과 특화된 문항에서 더 높은 신뢰도를 보여 맞춤형 GPT 기반 자동채점 서비스의 효과성을 확인할 수 있었다. 다만 학생의 개별 경험이나 배경지식을 반영해야 하는 문항에서는 교사 평가와의 일치도가 다른 문항에 비해 다소 낮았다(이차 가중 카파계수 0.43~0.51). 이는 자동채점 서비스가 교사의 최종 평가를 보조하는 도구로 활용되어야 하며, 평가의 특성에 따라 교사의 검토와 조정이 필요함을 시사한다. 본 연구는 학교 현장에 즉시 활용할 수 있도록 인공지능 기술을 활용한 자동채점 서비스를 실제적으로 개발하고 적용 가능성을 탐색했다는 점에서 의의가 있으며, 향후 서비스의 고도화 방향과 교육 현장에서의 활용 방안을 제언하였다.

abstract_ko: This study aimed to explore the potential of using generative AI as a tool for teaching and learning similar grammar patterns in Korean. To do so, explanations were requested from four generative AI models using example sentences of beginner-level Korean grammar contrasts presented on the National Institute of Korean Language’s ‘Center for teaching and learning Korean’ website. The experiment was conducted with four freely accessible generative AIs available to learners—ChatGPT-4o, Gemini, Clova X, and Wrtn. For each grammar contrast, both grammatical and ungrammatical sentences were inputted, and the AIs were asked to explain the reason for the differences. A total of 109 grammar contrasts and their example sentences were used to formulate the questions. The AI responses were categorized into three types: clearly correct, not incorrect but vague, and incorrect. As a result of analyzing the AI responses, ChatGPT showed the highest accuracy, followed by Gemini, Wrtn, and Clova X. Analysis of incorrect responses revealed several issues: failure to explain idiomatic usages of grammar, inadequate explanation of morphological constraints, identifying ungrammatical sentences as grammatical, grammatical errors in the explanations or corrected sentences, and providing explanations based on meanings different from those intended in the example sentences. Based on these findings, the study suggests using learners’ own writing or speaking data or ‘Korean Learners’ Corpus Search Engine’ as learning materials for similar grammar tasks using generative AI. It is proposed that learners can independently identify the causes of grammatical errors through interactions with generative AI. abstract_ko: 이 연구는 텍스트 구조 관점에서 DeepSeek와 ChatGPT 기반 TOPIK 논증 글쓰기의 구조 특징을 비교·분석하고, 인공지능 모델의 한계점 및 개선 방안을 제시하는 것이 목적이다. 기존 연구가 단일 인공지능, 대체로 ChatGPT를 기반으로만 텍스트 분석 연구를 진행한 한계를 극복하고자, 본 연구는 새로운 인공지능 모델을 포함한 비교 분석을 통해 모델 간 상호 발전 방안을 찾고자 하였다. abstract_ko: This study aims to investigate Korean language teachers' interest in, understanding of, and experience with AI, as well as their expectations and concerns regarding AI technologies. The research aims to understand the diverse perspectives teachers hold about AI and, based on these insights, to propose more practical and effective ways of integrating AI into Korean language education. To this end, a quantitative survey was conducted among instructors in the field of Korean language education, and qualitative research was carried out through in-depth interviews with instructors who have experience using AI in their teaching. A triangulation approach was applied to develop quantitative survey items and semi-structured interview questions focused on the role and application of AI in the educational setting. The collected data were analyzed for reliability and validity, and the expert interview findings were organized to complement the survey results. The findings revealed that text-generating AI and translation AI can enhance the potential for personalized instruction by allowing teachers to provide prompt feedback on learners' writing and pronunciation. Many Korean language teachers recognized AI as a useful supplementary tool in education and evaluated it positively, particularly in terms of saving time and improving efficiency in lesson preparation and learner feedback. The study thus highlights the significance of enhancing teachers’AI literacy and promoting further research and practice of AI-based educational models in language learning for educational innovation.

abstract_ko: This study examines the ethical awareness of undergraduate international students regarding the use of generative AI tools for academic writing. As technologies such as ChatGPT and Bing AI become increasingly prevalent in higher education, students—particularly those writing in a second language—face complex dilemmas concerning authorship, plagiarism, and responsibility. To explore these issues, this study implemented a dilemma-based discussion model for international undergraduate students in a writing course at a Korean university. Using a mixed-methods approach, the study conducted a 12-item survey which was administered before and after the discussion sessions, and the results were analyzed using paired-samples t-tests and Cohen's d. The analysis revealed significant improvements in students' ethical awareness, especially regarding authorship and accountability for AI-generated content. Additionally, thematic analysis of the resarch participants' reflective journals identified four key themes: distancing themselves from AI dependency, the emergence of authorship identity, greater moral responsibility, and the internalization of academic integrity. The findings suggest that dilemma-based discussions foster ethical reasoning and critical digital literacy, offering a promising approach to AI-integrated writing instruction for diverse student populations.

abstract_ko: This study investigates the potential and limitations of generative artificial intelligence (AI) in Korean language education by evaluating how well current models identify and correct syntactic errors made by learners. Multilingual models (ChatGPT, Claude) and Korean-specific models (EXAONE, QwenKO) were tested using a learner corpus. The results revealed notable performance differences. EXAONE showed high accuracy in error detection, highlighting the strengths of Korean-focused models, but its performance in error correction was limited and inconsistent across error types. Claude and GPT demonstrated more balanced results, particularly in rewriting corrected sentences, while QwenKO showed generally low accuracy. Overall, Korean-specific models excelled in identifying errors, whereas larger multilingual models performed better in sentence-level correction. All models struggled with errors requiring contextual or pragmatic understanding, suggesting that current AI systems still lack discourse-level competence. This study provides empirical insight into the capabilities of generative AI for syntactic error processing and offers pedagogical considerations for its informed application in Korean language instruction.

abstract_ko: This study aimed to design a metaverse-based space for discussion-oriented teaching and learning using the ZEP platform and to examine its educational validity and feasibility. Unlike prior research that primarily emphasized temporary engagement, this study structured spaces around pedagogical needs, emphasizing learner participation and moderator roles. The proposed design comprised five universal spaces and four specialized spaces dedicated to discussion practices, which were refined through a literature review, teacher focus group interviews, usability testing, and expert evaluation. The results suggest that the metaverse-based space effectively promotes interaction and visualization of discussion procedures and offers an environment for practicing various discussion formats. Teaching and learning spaces in the metaverse may offer innovative educational solutions, especially for schools facing spatial constraints.

abstract_ko: Sign language is a fully developed linguistic system using visual-gestural elements such as hand movements, facial expressions, and spatial organization. While deep learning has advanced American Sign Language (ASL) research, applying these methods to Korean Sign Language (KSL) faces challenges due to KSL's classifier predicates, spatial referencing, and topic-comment structures. This paper critically reviews ASL-based deep learning in Sign Language Recognition (SLR), Sign Language Production (SLP), and Sign Language Translation (SLT) to assess their adaptation for KSL. In this review, SLR covers the automatic recognition of sign sequences from visual input, SLP addresses the generation of natural sign gestures from text or speech, and SLT focuses on translating between sign and spoken languages. Methodologically, we conduct a comparative literature review of state-of-the-art deep learning models, analyzing their architectures, training strategies, and evaluation metrics within each subfield (SLR, SLP, SLT). We examine linguistic differences between ASL and KSL, noting difficulties in gesture synthesis, spatial modeling, and non-manual feature integration. We highlight limitations of direct ASL-to-KSL model transfer and propose multi-modal learning, expanded datasets, and enhanced spatial encoding to advance KSL processing technologies.

abstract_ko: This study examines utterance fluency in advanced L2 Korean learners from Chinese and Vietnamese L1 backgrounds, relative to native speakers, using a multidimensional framework spanning speed, pauses, repairs, and prosody. Twenty-one native speakers and sixty-two TOPIK Level 5–6 learners completed a story-retelling task. Speech was analyzed for articulation rate (AR), intra-clausal pause ratio (ICPR), mean length of run (MLR), total pause ratio (TPR), self-repair/repetition rate (SRR), and pitch dynamism quotient (PDQ). In classification, both models exceeded a majority-class baseline, achieving roughly 90–93% out-of-sample accuracy. abstract_ko: This study examines the effects of AI ChatGPT-based Problem-Based Learning (PBL) on the Korean speaking abilities of Chinese learners at intermediate and advanced levels. Eighteen learners participated via Zoom, and learning outcomes were assessed using pre- and post-surveys. Results showed significant improvement for intermediate learners, but little change for advanced learners. Sub-factor analysis indicated that advanced learners improved in anxiety and satisfaction, while intermediate learners showed broader gains in self-efficacy, engagement, anxiety, and satisfaction, with self-efficacy improving most. Feedback revealed that intermediate learners benefited from grammar correction and presentation confidence but struggled with complex responses and reliance on AI. Advanced learners reported cognitive and expressive gains but noted weak logical flow and limited cultural understanding. Overall, ChatGPT-based PBL speaking lessons were more effective for intermediate than advanced learners.

abstract_ko: 생성형 AI 기술이 언어 교육 분야에서 널리 활용되면서 교사의 AI 이용의도에 대한 영향 메커니즘이 연구의 핵심 과제로 주목을 받고 있다. 본 연구는 중국 내 한국어 교사를 연구대상으로 설정한 후, UTAUT 모델을 기반으로 자기효능감, TPACK 프레임의 테크놀로지 지식과 지각된 리스크를 추가하여 생성형 AI 작문 도구에 대한 교사 이용의도의 확장된 모델을 구축했다. 유효 설문지 총 606부를 수집하여 구조방정식 모델을 분석했다. 분석 결과, 첫째, 자기효능감은 성과 기대를 통해 행동의도에 긍정적인 영향을 미쳤다. 둘째, 노력 기대, 사회적 영향과 촉진 조건은 모두 행동의도에 긍정적인 영향을 미쳤다. 셋째, 지각된 리스크는 행동의도에 부정적인 영향을 미쳤다. 넷째, 테크놀로지 지식은 성과 기대와 행동의도 간의 관계에서 긍정적인 조절효과가 있는 것으로 나타났다. 본 연구 결과는 UTAUT 모델을 확장 및 검증했다. 그리고 한국어 교사의 테크놀로지 지식 수준 향상, 교육 지원 환경 최적화, 리스크 인식과 윤리 교육 강화, 중국 현지화 AI 도구 개발 등 제언을 제시했다. 본 연구의 목적은 중국 내 한국어 교사의 이용의도에 영향을 미치는 주요 메커니즘을 제시하는 데 있다. 교사의 이용의도는 교육 과정에서 생성형 AI 작문 도구를 실제로 접목하고 보급하기 위한 전제 조건이 된다. 본 연구는 UTAUT 모델의 응용 범위를 확장했을 뿐만 아니라 새로운 교육 기술 수용 과정에서 교사의 심리 및 행동 메커니즘을 이해하는 데 중요한 실증 근거를 제시했다.

abstract_ko: 본 논문은 AI 디지털 전환이 가속화되는 맥락에서 한국어교육의 교육 문화를 진단하고, 한국어 교 원의 역할과 과제를 재정의한다. 먼저 국내⋅외 동향과 정책 자료를 토대로 AI 시대 교육 문화의 특 징을 정리하고, 한국어교육 맥락에서 세종학당의 메타버스⋅온라인 강좌⋅AI 기반 평가 등 디지털 전 환 사례를 통해 현장의 변화를 제시하였다. 이러한 변화 속에서 한국어 교원의 핵심 역할은 기능적 지 식 전달을 넘어, 언어와 문화를 통합해 의미를 맥락화하는 문화적 전달자이자, 학습 데이터를 해석하 여 형성평가를 강화하는 학습 설계자의 역할, AI 활용의 장점과 한계를 고려한 윤리적 권위자의 역할 이 강화된다. 특히 레비나스의 ‘타자에 대한 책임’ 관점을 고려하여, 교원이 학습자의 문화적 배경을 환대하고 교육적 타당성을 함께 성찰하는 윤리적 주체임을 강조하였다. 이에 따른 과제로는 기술과 교육의 균형 유지, 디지털 리터러시 함양을 위한 지속적인 재교육 기회와 정보 교류의 장 마련, 첨단 기술을 활용한 문화 교육 프로그램을 다양화하고 현지의 한국 문화 수요를 반영하려는 노력 필요, AI 기반 콘텐츠의 평가 신뢰도를 확보할 수 있도록 교원의 조력이 필요, 디지털 사용으로 인한 학습자의 격차 해소를 제안한다. 결론적으로, 한국어 교원은 AI를 도구로 활용하되 인간적⋅문화적 판단을 중 심축으로 삼는 통합적 전문성을 정립해야 하며, 이는 한국어 학습의 효과와 문화적 이해를 동시 증진 하는 실천 전략이 된다.

abstract_ko: 2022년 말 챗지피티의 등장 이래로 언어 인공지능은 개발자 중심 시대에서 사용자 중심 시대로 전환되었다. 인공지능 비전공 연구자들과 일반 사용자들도 초고성능의 LLM을 자유롭게 접하고 사용할 수 있게 되면서, 대학 스피치 교육 영역에서도 LLM을 활용한 연구가 급속히 증가했다. 이러한 상황에도 불구하고 스피치 교육 현장에는 LLM 도입이 적극적으로 이뤄지지 않고 있다. 핵심 원인 중 하나는 LLM에 내재된 성능 불안정성 때문이다. 본 연구에서는 LLM의 성능 안정성을 높이기 위한 해법을 수사학과 공학의 융합을 통해 구상하고 구현하여, 스피치 평가 루브릭 기반의 LLM 성능 평가 프레임워크를 구상하고 실험하였다. 실험 결과 LLM의 성능 안정성에 대한 평가의 가능성, LLM간 성능 안정성 비교 가능성, LLM의 불안정성을 개선한 성능 보완의 가능성, LLM 성능 평가 프레임워크의 구현 가능성을 확인했다. 이는 향후 개발자 단계가 아닌 사용자 단계에서도 LLM 성능 안정화가 가능함을 의미하는 것이며, 향후 LLM 도입 확대의 가능성을 높일 것으로 기대된다. 본 연구는 스피치 교육과 같은 전문 분야로의 LLM 도입 가능성의 확대란 점에서 또한 수사학과 인공지능학의 본격적인 융합 연구란 점에서 큰 의의를 갖는다 할 수 있다
abstract_en: Since the appearance of ChatGPT at the end of 2022, language-oriented artificial intelligence has shifted from a developer-centered to a user-centered paradigm. As non-specialist researchers and lay users have gained ready access to and the ability to employ high-performance large language models (LLMs), research employing LLMs in university-level speech education has increased rapidly. Despite this surge in research, however, the actual introduction of LLMs into speech instruction remains limited. One principal reason for this lag is the inherent instability of LLM performance.
